what: Every club depth chart is labelled 'unofficial' by the club that publishes it.
why: 31 of 31 readable charts carry a self-declared unofficial label, so no chart can be treated as a club-authoritative starter designation.
action: Use official gamebook participation data as ground truth (S-02).

what: 27 of 32 club depth charts print no 'as of' date, so freshness cannot be proven.
why: Only CHI, GB, LV, SF and TEN print a date. The others give no evidence of when the chart was last updated.
action: Diff each chart on every run and alert when a chart has not changed in 7 days (S-02).

what: Detroit lists Cade Mays as its starting centre while the official injury report lists him Out.
why: The club chart is not synced to the injury report. Trusting the chart would have produced a wrong starter.
action: Already handled: the pipeline treats the injury report as authoritative for availability.

what: Philadelphia's depth chart lists Hollywood Brown and Fred Johnson, both waived by the club on 2026-11-13.
why: The club's own news page and the club's own depth chart disagree.
action: Treat club transaction news as an override on the next ingest run.

what: Houston's official depth chart is published only as an image; no rows could be read.
why: The page renders the chart inside a picture, so there is no machine-readable table.
action: Switch the whole depth layer to official gamebook participation data (S-02).

what: No market lines exist anywhere in the system.
why: No spread, total, moneyline or player-prop price has been ingested, so no signal can be converted into a bet or scored against the market.

what: No game log has been ingested.
why: Without week-by-week results there is no home-field-advantage estimate and no schedule-strength adjustment, so the model runs uncalibrated.

what: All model lines are produced with home-field advantage = 0.0 and no schedule adjustment.
why: Both parameters need a game log. Publishing an uncalibrated number that looks like a line is how a bad model gets trusted.
action: Close Q-10 and Q-11, then recalibrate (S-07).

what: 185 of 345 injury rows have a blank game status, and 21 of those also show the player did not practise.
why: The official report leaves the Game Status column empty for a majority of listed players, so availability cannot be read from that column alone. Counted against the official page: 66 Out, 10 Doubtful, 84 Questionable.
action: Cross-check against the official inactives list (Q-05, S-06).

what: 17 players ruled Out or Doubtful are absent from their own club's depth chart.
why: Players on injured reserve or recently signed are frequently missing from the chart, so the chart cannot be used as a completeness check.
action: Treat absence from the chart as an unknown, never as 'healthy'.

what: The base commit contains 45 tracked file(s) totalling 925245 bytes.
why: There is no licence, no .gitignore, no CI, no tests, no documentation and no branch protection recorded at the base commit.
action: Add licence, .gitignore, CI and branch protection.
